implemented: Default-off rules with folder/subfolder and all-tag matching; empty conditions explicitly mean unrestricted
Rule-specific frozen PDF recipe copy, logical destination, scan paper/DPI/quality/OCR settings and stable delay
Rule settings/profile/backup integration; no network permission or automatic task when all rules disabled
Room document/page/revision/OCR record signals, capture-pending gate, source/rule fingerprint and durable task deduplication
Coalescing obsolete queued changes; explicit activation epoch on re-enable; manual run can request another copy
Frozen scan snapshot and original/dewarp/OCR resource references; existing PDF source remains unchanged
AUTO_EXPORT WorkManager jobs use the heavy-pipeline budget and reusable RecipeJobs stages; base PDF checkpoint has its own parameter version

Rule disable/delete cancels active jobs; originals are never deleted by the automation

Completed PDF is in output history and not in listed source documents
